compatibility_patches.name: build_rusty_v8_from_source_for_i686_musl
compatibility_patches.reason: Current upstream codex-cli does not depend on v8; the obsolete source-build workaround is intentionally skipped.
compatibility_patches.effect: Avoids a multi-gigabyte V8 cache/source build for a dependency codex-cli no longer uses.

compatibility_patches.name: raise_mcp_server_recursion_limit
compatibility_patches.reason: Current upstream codex-mcp-server type queries exceed Rust's default recursion depth in release builds.

compatibility_patches.name: i686_musl_linux_sandbox_syscall_compile_fix
compatibility_patches.reason: libc syscall constants are i32 on i686 musl and libc does not expose SYS_accept for this target.
compatibility_patches.effect: Linux sandbox syscall table code compiles for the i686 musl release target.

compatibility_patches.name: i686_musl_blake3_pure_compile_fix
compatibility_patches.reason: blake3 compiles AVX512 C intrinsics on 32-bit x86 by default, and zig clang rejects that path for i686 musl.
compatibility_patches.effect: blake3 uses its pure Rust fallback for this target so the i686 musl release can compile.

compatibility_patches.name: build_bundled_liblzma_for_i686_musl
compatibility_patches.reason: Cross-enabled pkg-config can select the Linux runner's x86_64 liblzma archive while linking the i686 musl executable.
compatibility_patches.effect: lzma-sys compiles and links its bundled target liblzma, and the build rejects host-architecture search paths.
